newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SABENA SELLS CARGO DIVISION TO SWISSAIR.
newsitem.headline: SABENA SELLS CARGO DIVISION TO SWISSAIR.

text.p: Belgian national airline Sabena said on Wednesday it was selling its cargo division to its partner Swissair.
"Sabena will no longer have a cargo division (and) Swissair's cargo capacity will jump 25 percent," a Sabena spokesman told Reuters. He declined to give financial details.
The spokesman said Sabena's cargo would be commercialised by Swissair Cargo from January 1, 1997.
Sabena said in a statement the cargo cooperation deal was approved last week by Sabena chief executive Paul Reutlinger and Swissair president Philippe Bruggisser.
Sabena said Swissair's cargo clients will get access to Sabena's European and African network. Sabena currently flies to 58 European, 22 African and four U.S. destinations plus Tokyo.
Sabena's clients can use Swissair's Asian and North- and South American networks.
